text: If the zombie apocalypse starts on a cruise ship, and something's moving in the lifeboat...
Rule one. Don't open anything until you know what's inside.
So you knock. And something knocks back.
It's not a zombie. It's Marco, a deckhand. He's been hiding in there all night.
Rule two. Never lower a lifeboat alone.
One person works the winch. Someone has to ride it down.
And it's a long way down.
Marco knows the crew corridors. Passages the passengers never see.
That's how you get around them.
You try the radio. Static. Nobody's answering.
Nobody on the bridge touched it.
